text: {"assertions":["A data loss bug in mobile/android/OfflineCache.kt was caused by two writes that were not wrapped in a transaction.","The offline cache bug only manifested for jobs scheduled across the midnight boundary.","The bug's symptom was a local row missing after the next app launch.","The fix involved wrapping both writes in a single transaction and was submitted as PR #2013 on branch fix/data-loss-1.","The bug can be reproduced by force stopping the app while it has unsynced edits.","Memory usage improved from climbing past 7 GB to settling at 330 MB after applying the fix.","The offline cache code is implemented in Kotlin on the mobile sync side.","The offline cache bug is covered by tests in mobile/android/OfflineCacheTest.kt."]}
